🎥🎬: Reese Calloway – All’s Fair (2026)

When the powerful women at Grant, Ronson & Greene realize their law firm needs a proper human resources department, they bring in Reese Calloway, a young, Yale-educated HR specialist with experience working at one of their biggest competitors. Hoping to improve the firm’s workplace culture, Reese arrives with fresh ideas and a very different approach to professional conduct.

However, her arrival quickly creates unexpected tension. Reese begins addressing workplace complaints, including concerns about how some of the firm’s senior partners dress and present themselves. Even simple office interactions become opportunities for discussions about workplace standards, inclusion and professional boundaries.

As Reese settles into her new position, the attorneys discover that bringing in HR might create just as many complications as it solves. In a firm already filled with strong personalities, complicated relationships and internal rivalries, Reese is about to make her presence felt.
